column1: ## P0-08 real-data candidate assessment, 2026-09-18. PBMC prioritised at the user's direction.
## Data lives OFF the repo and off $HOME (B003: /home is 96% full):
##   /exports/para-lipg-hpc/mdmanurung/cnmf-realdata/raw/
## This file is the tracked manifest; the .h5ad files are not in version control.
## Fetched by direct URL read from pertpy's own source rather than by installing pertpy.
## Installing it into `cnmf_bench` would change `environment_hash`, which is recorded
## provenance on all 1342 existing rows and underpins D004's same-environment tolerance
## claim. Downloading a file and reading it with the already-present anndata changes nothing.
dataset
kang_2018
stephenson_2021_subsampled
## kang_2018                  -> USABLE
## stephenson_2021_subsampled -> NOT USABLE AS DISTRIBUTED (no counts anywhere in the file)
## ---- THE CHECK THAT DECIDED IT: is `.X` raw integer counts? ----
## cNMF needs counts. `compute_tpm` and the PROTOCOL 3.2 transform are both meaningless on
## normalised input, and NOTHING RAISES -- the pipeline returns numbers either way. This was
## flagged as the primary trap before either file was downloaded, and it fired immediately.
dataset
kang_2018
stephenson_2021_subsampled
## Stephenson evidence: max 7.5257 is a log1p signature; nonzero values repeat exactly
## (0.22479707), which is what per-cell normalisation produces; row sums are ~1259-1458
## rather than integers. `layers` is empty and `.raw` is None, so the counts are not merely
## hidden elsewhere in the file -- they are absent. The pertpy docstring explains why: cells
## were "mapped to a reference atlas of healthy PBMCs from 12 studies with scArches", and the
## distributed object is the processed result of that mapping.
## This does not make Stephenson unusable in principle -- the raw counts exist at the
## original source (Stephenson et al. 2021 Nat Med, Haniffa lab; ArrayExpress E-MTAB-10026
## and covid19cellatlas.org). It makes the PERTPY DISTRIBUTION unusable. Recorded so the
## 669 MB download is not repeated by anyone reading this.
## ---- KANG 2018 STRUCTURE, measured ----
## 24,673 cells x 15,706 genes, no duplicate gene names, 0 cells below 200 counts.
## The donor column is named `replicate`, not `donor` -- a name that would silently pass an
## eyeball check for "is there donor structure" and find nothing.
donor
patient_101
patient_107
patient_1015
patient_1016
patient_1039
patient_1244
patient_1256
patient_1488
## 8 donors; cells/donor 1042 - 5090, median 3350.
## Library size min 562, median 1246, max 11816 -- shallow, this is 2017-era 10x chemistry.
## ---- TWO PROPERTIES THAT MAKE IT A CLEAN TEST ----
## 1. CONDITION IS NOT CONFOUNDED WITH DONOR. The stim fraction ranges 0.438 - 0.582 across
##    the eight donors, so every donor contributes both arms in near-equal measure. The
##    IFN-beta activity program is therefore separable from donor identity, which is exactly
##    the confound that would make an activity-recovery claim uninterpretable.
## 2. EVERY CELL TYPE IS PRESENT IN EVERY DONOR (8/8 for all eight types). Contrast the
##    simulator's own DEVELOPMENT fold outer_0, where one identity program had a SINGLE
##    training carrier donor. Kang has no such degeneracy, so it tests a different regime --
##    and the simulator remains the only place that degenerate case can be studied.
cell_type
CD4 T cells
CD14+ Monocytes
B cells
NK cells
CD8 T cells
FCGR3A+ Monocytes
Dendritic cells
Megakaryocytes
## Megakaryocytes reach 1 cell in the thinnest donor: a genuine rare population, and the
## natural real-data test for rare-program recovery.
## ---- WHAT KANG CAN AND CANNOT ANSWER ----
## CAN: does cNMF recover a KNOWN ACTIVITY PROGRAM? The interferon-beta response is induced,
## strong, and carries a per-cell `label` (stim/ctrl, 12358/12315). An inferred program that
## tracks that label is checkable against a recorded fact rather than against a judgement
## about whether a gene list "looks biological" -- which is the unfalsifiable reasoning this
## programme exists to avoid. This is the closest thing to ground truth real data offers, and
## it fills the gap that every identity-only dataset leaves.
## CANNOT: test feature A well. EIGHT DONORS IS THIN. Two outer folds gives 4 train / 4 test
## before inner folds, against the simulator's 24. D008 already established that donor COUNT
## is the dominant effect (t = +4.30) and per-donor leakage is not (t = -0.37), so a
## donor-blocking result at n = 8 would be measuring the thing D008 says dominates. Kang is
## not the dataset for A's premise and should not be used to claim anything about it.
## ---- NOT YET VERIFIED ----
## LICENSES FOR BOTH. AGENTS.md requires inspecting licenses before reuse and none has been
## read. Kang 2018 originates at GEO GSE96583; the pertpy redistribution's terms are
## unstated. No result may be published from either until this is closed.
## Also unverified: whether gene symbols need deduplication against the cNMF gene-list path,
## and whether the shallow library sizes interact with `num_highvar_genes` selection.

column1: ## HEART CELL ATLAS v2 -- fetched 2026-09-18, at the user's request
dataset
heart_cell_atlas_v2_global_raw
## Byte count verified against the server's content-length before hashing.
## Companion files on the same host, not fetched: v2 Global_lognormalised.h5ad (8.73 GB),
## v1/Litvinukova global_raw.h5ad (5.07 GB, 486K cells), v1 ventricular CM raw (1.69 GB).
## LICENSE: CC BY 4.0 with an attribution requirement (Human Cell Atlas data use terms,
## data.humancellatlas.org/about/data-use-agreement). This is the FIRST of the three
## candidates whose license has actually been read. Kang's remains unverified.
## Citation: "Spatially resolved multiomics of human cardiac niches", Nature, 12 July 2023.
## ---- RAW COUNTS: CONFIRMED ----
## .X min 1.0, max 2213.0, integer-valued. 0 duplicate gene names in 32,732.
## Unlike the Stephenson redistribution above, this file is what its name says.
## ---- 22 DONORS in the object ----
## heartcellatlas.org describes the STUDY as 25 adult donors (14F/11M, ages 20-75). The
## Global object carries 22. The discrepancy is recorded, not resolved -- do not quote 25.
## cells/donor 5,757 - 75,191, median 29,765. All 12 cell types present in all 22 donors
## except Mesothelial cell (19/22).
## ---- THE CONFOUND THAT DECIDES HOW THIS IS USED ----
## The object mixes WHOLE CELLS and NUCLEI: 135,698 'Cell' against 568,598 'Nuclei'.
## Nuclei lack cytoplasmic and mitochondrial mRNA, so the two have systematically different
## profiles. Running cNMF across the whole object would produce a leading program that is the
## ASSAY rather than any biology, and it would look like a confident, well-supported factor.
## The object must be sliced to one assay before use.
## Worse, ASSAY IS CONFOUNDED WITH DONOR -- the slices do not share their donor sets:
slice
scRNA_whole_cells
snRNA_nuclei
Multiome-RNA
## So the 22-donor figure is not available to any single coherent analysis. Choosing an assay
## costs donors, which is the quantity D008 identified as dominant.
## ---- RECOMMENDED SLICE: snRNA nuclei, 357,538 cells, 14 donors ----
## Best donor count of the three coherent slices, generous depth (median 17,425 cells/donor
## after slicing), and 10 of 12 cell types present in all 14 donors.
cell_type
Ventricular Cardiomyocyte
Fibroblast
Mural cell
Atrial Cardiomyocyte
Endothelial cell
Myeloid
Lymphoid
Adipocyte
Neural cell
Mast cell
Mesothelial cell
Lymphatic Endothelial cell
## Lymphatic Endothelial (446), Mesothelial (649) and Mast (1227) are genuine rare
## populations -- the real-data counterpart to the simulator's rare identity programs.
## ---- A NESTING THAT MUST BE STATED IN ANY FEATURE-A RESULT ----
## Within the snRNA slice, 10x KIT IS FULLY NESTED IN DONOR: zero donors use more than one
## kit (3prime-v3 190,497 cells; 3prime-v2 167,041). Donor-blocked CV therefore holds out
## chemistry along with the donor, so a "generalises to an unseen donor" number here is
## partly "generalises to an unseen chemistry". This is arguably the honest real-world
## setting -- a new cohort usually arrives on whatever chemistry is current -- but it is NOT
## the clean donor effect the simulator isolates, and a result quoted without this caveat
## would overstate what was measured.
## ---- STANDING AGAINST THE OTHER CANDIDATES ----
## donors:  Kang 8  <  heart snRNA 14  <  simulator DEVELOPMENT 24
## Heart is the best real donor structure obtained so far and still below the tier the
## simulator runs at. Kang keeps its distinct role: it is the only candidate with a KNOWN
## ACTIVITY PROGRAM carrying a per-cell label, which heart does not have at all.

## CELLXGENE DISCOVER -- a SYSTEMATIC source of raw counts, not a single dataset
## Queried api.cellxgene.cziscience.com/curation/v1/datasets on 2026-09-18: 2,228 datasets.
## WHY THIS SOURCE IS DIFFERENT: the CZI schema MANDATES both of the things every candidate
## above had to be checked for by hand. Quoting schema 7.0.0:
##   raw counts: "Values MUST be de-duplicated molecule counts. Each cell MUST contain at
##   least one non-zero value. All non-zero values MUST be positive integers stored as
##   numpy.float32." ... "MUST be stored in AnnData.raw.X unless no normalized matrix
##   exists, in which case they go in AnnData.X."
##   donor_id: "MUST NOT be 'na', but MUST be free-text that identifies a unique individual
##   that data were derived from" (except for cell lines).
## So raw counts and donor identity are STRUCTURAL GUARANTEES here, not properties to hope
## for. Every dataset also carries an explicit license and DOI.
## ---- A GOTCHA THAT INVERTS THE EARLIER CHECK ----
## On CellxGene, `.X` IS NORMALISED and the raw counts live in `.raw.X`. The integrality test
## that correctly rejected the Stephenson redistribution above would therefore return a FALSE
## NEGATIVE on a perfectly good CellxGene dataset. For this source, test `.raw.X` first and
## fall back to `.X` only when `.raw` is None.
## ---- DO NOT USE x_approximate_distribution AS THE COUNTS INDICATOR ----
## It is populated for only 76 of 2,228 datasets (40 COUNT, 36 NORMAL, 2,152 null). All three
## candidates below report null. The schema guarantee is the reliable fact; this field is not.
## ---- HIGHEST-DONOR HUMAN BLOOD/PBMC DATASETS AVAILABLE ----
dataset
OneK1K_Yazar_2022
AIDA_Phase1_v2
Perez_2022_lupus_PBMC

## Other high-donor human tissue seen in the same index, for the record: MSSM dorsolateral

## USEFUL is a separate question from whether it is obtainable -- at that scale the binding
## constraint becomes compute, and D008's finding that donor count dominates means a result
## at n=981 answers a different question from one at n=24.
